observed_control_gap.description: The detached supervisor caught a continuation-preflight exception outside the recovery-specific error class and reduced it to unexpected_supervisor_failure without preserving a sanitized exception category.
observed_control_gap.effect: The exact cause cannot be reconstructed from the terminal evidence even though the stop boundary and absence of a continuation attempt are verifiable.
observed_control_gap.prohibited_inference: A later passing read-only source check does not prove what failed at the recorded terminal time.

implementation_controls: create a new continuation-only broker and detached-supervisor identity that cannot call the recovery-002 transfer path

classify approved acquisition-control exceptions by their existing nonsecret code and classify all other exceptions without recording exception messages, tracebacks, URLs containing credentials, or credential values
write append-only nonsecret supervisor start, heartbeat, per-source phase, and terminal evidence outside Git
prove synthetically that a continuation preflight failure produces its exact safe control code and no product attempt, staging payload, or destination
prove synthetically that an unexpected exception produces a generic terminal code without its message or synthetic credential

prove the source allowlist and order, one-attempt-per-source ceiling, stop-on-first-failure rule, no M1-SRC-004 request, exclusive staging, redirect refusal, path containment, exact length and checksum checks, and atomic no-replace promotion
publish the exact implementation and tests, verify the remote commit, and require successful public CI before activation, credential entry, or a payload request
activation_and_real_run_preconditions: the exact proposal and review bundle have one completed approving owner response that is locked and reconciled
the exact implementation commit exists on origin/main and its public CI run succeeds
the successful M1-SRC-004 recovery, its container receipt, both retained partials, and the stopped supervisor terminal evidence match their bound identities
all four continuation assets remain authorized with zero attempts and absent staging, event, and destination paths
the current normalized CDSE legal section, structured modification date, OData documentation, token documentation, and Sentinel Legal Notice match their accepted controls
each exact provider UUID, product name, online state, catalog length, and provider checksum matches the approved source manifest
a fresh owner-controlled access token is supplied only through the tested in-memory broker channel
per_source_controls: perform the live legal and exact catalog preflight before that source's payload request
stream only the complete exact product from byte zero without Range or resume semantics into a new exclusive staging path
compute local SHA-256 and provider MD5 while streaming
require exact catalog length and provider MD5 before atomic no-replace promotion
rehash the promoted archive and run the existing offline ZIP and SAFE container verification without extraction
proceed to the next exact source only after the current source has both a successful transfer receipt and pass_container_only receipt
completion_release: reconcile the four exact continuation assets into the active intake only from their successful attempt and container receipts
mark the eight-product transfer and container-verification cohort complete only if all eight exact products are promoted and container-verified
return to separately governed materialization and pixel-readiness gates; do not infer pixel usability or scientific fitness
proposed_continuation.failure_policy: Any continuation transfer, verification, identity, legal, credential-custody, path, or control failure is terminal for the run, preserves all evidence, stops before later products, and requires a new exact owner review. No automatic retry is authorized.

approval_would_authorize: implement and synthetically validate only the exact continuation-only detached-worker correction described here
publish and independently verify the exact implementation through a successful public-CI gate
perform a final no-payload preflight and one owner token handoff through the tested in-memory broker
attempt each of M1-SRC-005, M1-SRC-006, M1-SRC-008, and M1-SRC-010 at most once, in that order, stopping on the first failure
verify and promote each exact product only when every current rights, identity, secret-custody, length, checksum, path, interruption, and container control passes
reconcile successful continuation receipts into the existing eight-product intake
approval_would_not_authorize: transfer, retry, replace, delete, modify, or reverify M1-SRC-004 beyond read-only identity checks
resume or reuse any partial, staging path, attempt identity, event, receipt, or supervisor identity
place a token in a command line, environment variable, file, repository record, log, event, heartbeat, exception message, or traceback
retry any continuation source or continue to later sources after a failure
change product identity, order, observation time, event role, sensor route, destination, source manifest, or provider
accept terms, create, recover, or modify an account, change MFA, incur cost, or disclose credentials
acquire substitute imagery, additional products, DEM data, or orbit files
perform SAFE materialization, pixel decoding, baseline processing, terrain correction, registration, change mapping, attribution, or scientific publication
limitations: The exact cause of the stopped continuation preflight is unknown and this proposal does not retroactively infer it.
The corrected exception classification improves future evidence but cannot recover the missing exception category from the completed run.
A fresh token or transfer can fail; no automatic retry is included.
Container success would establish archive identity and structural integrity only, not readable or usable pixels.
This proposal creates no authority until the exact review bundle is approved, locked, and reconciled and the later publication and preflight gates pass.
